summary: Social video app (InstaV) with follow functionality, UI layout (logo, notifications, profile/sign-out), and feed features.
known_issues: Follow button is unresponsive when tapped; follower/following counts not reflected in UI; follow relationship not persisted to backend

existing_features.title: Fix the follow/unfollow button on the UserProfilePage so that tapping it triggers the backend follow/unfollow mutation, shows a loading state during the call, updates the button label (Follow ↔ Following) upon success, and refreshes the displayed follower/following counts immediately after the action.

Wire up the follow/unfollow React Query mutation hooks in useQueries.ts to correctly call the backend actor's follow and unfollow methods, and invalidate the relevant profile and follower count queries on success.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix follow button: tapping does nothing, follower counts not updating, follow relationship not saving to backend

Ensure the backend follow/unfollow functions correctly persist the follow relationship between users, storing follower and following associations in stable state, and expose accurate follower/following count queries.
